cases.name: scripts moved under .claude/: compared there, not reported MISSING, a script the kit lacks is ADDED
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/kd-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/.claude/scripts
cp {{KIT}}/scripts/pre-audit.sh $R/.claude/scripts/
printf x > $R/.claude/scripts/local-tool.py
bash {{KIT}}/scripts/kit-diff.sh $R | grep -E 'scripts/(pre-audit\.sh|local-tool\.py)' | sort | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ';'
